record.excerpt: A base order fires when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 … Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (−2%, −5%, −9.5%, −16%, −25%) with 1.8× size scaling per rung. … Take Profit: 3% above average entry. … Stop Loss: None — ladder allocation is the structural risk cap. … Net Profit: +5,790.33 USDT (+5.79%) … Percent Profitable: 68.82% (64 / 93) … Profit Factor: 5.019 … Test Period: January 1, 2024 — June 28, 2026 (~30 months).
record.notes: ETH twin of c003 (same template, different asset/results); page shows Jun 28 without year, inferred 2026 from test period.

spec.claim_summary: A strategy opens a base position when 4-hour RSI(14) drops below 28 and averages down across five fixed deviation levels to target 3% above average entry with no stop loss.
spec.untestable_reason: The heart of the strategy is a five-rung averaging ladder with 1.8x size scaling and take-profit above the DCA-blended average entry, which cannot be expressed as single-position entry/exit rules.
assumptions: Asset ETHUSDT inferred from page context about ETH; the claim itself names no asset.
Timeframe 4h taken from '4h RSI(14)' in the claim.
Direction inferred as long from buying at negative deviations and targeting profit above average entry; claim never states long/short.
Base entry interpreted as crosses_below 28 as closest testable core of 'drops below 28'.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (-2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25%) with 1.8x size scaling per rung, including average-entry calculation and ladder allocation as structural risk cap.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take Profit '3% above average entry' requires the DCA-blended average entry; without the ladder it cannot be encoded as a fixed take_profit_pct above base entry, so take_profit_pct is left unset.

issues.problem: Omits core claim element: five averaging orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% with 1.8x size scaling. Spec tests only single base entry, which changes sizing, average entry and risk.
Claim requires 3% above average (DCA-blended) entry; spec encodes fixed 3% above base entry. Without the ladder the exit level is different and could change verdict.
